description.en: A climbing fern carries lobed leaf units on a long twining frond axis.
description.zh: 攀援蕨在长缠绕叶轴上着生裂叶单元。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Lygodium kaulfussi; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Lygodium kaulfussi 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Twining rachis and digitate lobes differ from the existing self-supporting pinnate fern rosette.
distinctness.zh: 缠绕叶轴和指状裂片区别于现有自立羽状蕨莲座。

modeling_brief.en: Build an open winding axis with spaced lobed blades; support contact is an artistic placement, not a new plant.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立疏开的卷绕轴及间隔裂叶片；支撑接触仅为美术摆放，不另计植物。

assets.uncertainty: The exact climbing substrate and extension are unknown.

sources.title: Fossil Plants of Fossil Butte
sources.supports: Eocene Lygodium, Salvinia and Nelumbo fossil context.

description.en: A fossil fan-like thallus widens upward from a narrow basal attachment.
description.zh: 化石扇状藻体由狭窄附着基部向上展开。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Flabellophyton, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Flabellophyton 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Continuous fan of fine radiating elements differs from open branching seaweeds and discrete leaf-bearing plants.
distinctness.zh: 连续细放射单元叶扇区别于疏开分枝海藻和具有分立叶片的植物。

modeling_brief.en: Use a shallow fan relief with several principal radiating ridges; retain a narrow base without inventing a root.
modeling_brief.zh: 用浅扇形浮雕及少数主要放射脊建形，保留窄基而不臆造根。

assets.uncertainty: Ediacaran specimen; affinity, original thickness and softness are not fully resolved.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. Ediacaran macrofossil; neoproterozoic is the agreed broader era facet.

sources.title: A tale of three taphonomic modes: the Ediacaran fossil Flabellophyton
sources.supports: Flabellophyton fanlike thalli and epibenthic interpretation.

description.en: Small flattened fossil bodies are commonly divided into two broad lobes.
description.zh: 小型扁平化石体常分成两个宽裂瓣。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Protosalvinia, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied. Biological affinity is unresolved.
scientific_scope.zh: Protosalvinia 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。 生物学归属尚未确定。

distinctness.en: Paired broad thallus lobes differ from branching algae, fern leaves and microbial structures.
distinctness.zh: 成对宽藻体状裂瓣区别于分枝藻、蕨叶及微生物构造。

modeling_brief.en: Create one bilobed compression relief with restrained surface mesh; no roots, sporangia or swimming structures are invented.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作单件双裂压型浮雕，表面网纹保守处理，不臆造根、孢子囊或游动结构。

assets.uncertainty: Affinity remains unresolved; alga is a provisional form label, not a confirmed taxonomic placement.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Protosalvinia and associated conodonts of the Upper Devonian
sources.supports: Flattened, commonly bilobed Protosalvinia remains and Devonian occurrence.

description.en: A central algal axis bears regular whorls of fine lateral branches.
description.zh: 中央藻轴具有规则轮生细侧枝。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Chaetocladus, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Chaetocladus 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Repeated open brush whorls differ from unwhorled ribbon algae and Jimaodanus's two distinct lateral zones.
distinctness.zh: 重复疏开刷状轮枝区别于不轮生带藻及Jimaodanus两类侧枝区域。

modeling_brief.en: Build a linear fossil relief with regular radial attachment tiers; leave missing basal and apical ends unresolved.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立规则放射着生层的线状化石浮雕，缺失基部及顶端不补造。

assets.uncertainty: Genus-level form; species plates are needed to fix lateral branching and complete outline.
